text:
alex: @channel customer ticket #C-11234 — multiple 502/504s for hosted inference (acme-prod). Customers hitting timeouts, appears correlated with sudden traffic spike around 21:05 UTC. :rotating_light:

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2105. Alerts: high gateway 5xx rate, queue backlog.

samir: grabbing logs. early signal: KEDA scaler spiked, HPA target increased, but pods stayed Pending/ContainerCreating for ~35-50s each. Not enough warmup. :thinking_face:

jess: getting repro steps from support: curl -> POST /v1/generate returned 502 with body "upstream gateway timeout". Happens after 10s client timeout.

maya: I see readiness probe failures in pod logs during init: 
```
2026-03-17T21:04:57Z INF model-init: loading weights
2026-03-17T21:05:12Z ERR readiness: probe failed (timeout waiting for kv-cache warmup)
2026-03-17T21:05:20Z INF container: started, but model not ready
```

samir: scaledobject shows pollInterval 30s, cooldown 300s. KEDA reacted slowly because metrics source temporarily undercounted (metrics api throttled).

alex: so root issue = scale-up lag + readiness/warmup not met before routing traffic -> gateway returns 502/504. Also customer traffic burst -> queue backlog.

jess: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) increase minReplica for tenant pool, 2) route traffic to fallback smaller model variant, 3) temporarily pause KEDA and rely on HPA manual bump. Which is fastest?

oncall-sre: fastest is bump minReplica + enable prewarm annotation, or add a temporary static pool. I'll apply a quick patch to autoscaler policy for acme-prod and bump to 3 min replicas.

samir: Config snippets I recommend: 
```
# scaledobject snippet
pollingInterval: 5  # faster check
cooldownPeriod: 60
minReplicaCount: 3
triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      targetValue: "50"
```

maya: Also add startupProbe with longer timeout to avoid killing pods while model cold-starts. current liveness probe kills at 15s. change to 60s.

jess: I've updated support ticket with repro steps and told customer we're applying mitigations. They reported impact since 21:05 UTC, 40% of requests affected.

oncall-sre: Patch is applied (rolled out to acme-prod pool). Watching telemetry.

support-bot: Alert cleared for high 5xx rate (21:12 UTC) — monitoring for residuals.

alex: followups: - add prewarm pool for tiered customers - add test harness to simulate burst scale-ups - add playbook entry for KEDA metric throttling. I'll file tasks. :clipboard:

samir: saving command to reproduce locally if anyone needs: 
```
# simulate burst
seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P50 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

jess: thanks. marking postmortem required if SLA hit confirmed.

alex: thanks team. closing thread once postmortem task created. :thumbsup:
